content.title: Image One-question group check-in
content.summary: A digitally mediated image-reference version of this activity.
content.setup: Invite the group and choose when answers open and close.
content.participant: Send one text answer before the closing time. You can see your answer while the check-in is open.
content.completion: At the closing time, all submitted answers appear for the group. Missing answers do not delay the reveal.
content.access: Participants need a way to read the question and enter text. Missing an answer does not block the group.
